demand_rules.current_ordinary_rule: For eligible no-offpeak-election service below1000kW, all current 30-minute integrated maxima are undesignated off-peak and billed without75% time discount.
demand_rules.historical_source_excerpt: such off-peak or on-peak demand as used for billing
demand_rules.restricted_domain_inference: With no off-peak election throughout current/prior11months and all maxima <=100kW, use each month actual all-hours30-minute maximum as such demand; do not feed a ratchet-inflated billing demand back into ratchet history. This determinant interpretation is an explicit inference from D19 paragraphs1–3.
demand_rules.no_prior_data_policy: Reject missing required history unless independently documented true new-service start; do not assume zero.
demand_rules.excess_5_kw_adjustment: None in D19. T08 component tiering is separate.
demand_rules.base_minimum: Customer charge. No separate contract kW floor/PF surcharge stated in D19 ordinary-rate provisions.
demand_rules.special_connected_load_low_load_cap: Not applicable; reject this special provision.
demand_rules.primary_voltage_metering_billing_adjustm: kW and kWh reduced1%; excluded from ordinary secondary-metered subset.

low_load_factor.source_rule: D19 p2 limits Demand and Energy charge provisions jointly with T08. Customer charge is separate.
low_load_factor.comparator_from_supply_agent: Bill Calculator L16=Y only when L15<L14; equality ordinary. L14 includes separately rounded ordinary variable D19/T08 charge tests; excludes customer. L15=rounded combined Max Trigger times total kWh.
low_load_factor.selected_components: WhenY, D19 own low-load variable rate and T08 own low-load variable rate replace corresponding ordinary variable components; customer separately retained.
low_load_factor.percentage_base_from_supply_agent: D29/D36/D41 percent applies customer plus SELECTED D19 variable charge (ordinary or LLF); T08 excluded. D31 residential percent similarly base distribution by original terms.
low_load_factor.invoice_rounding_limitation: Do not claim exact rounded-invoice branch/optimizer parity from an unrounded algebraic comparator; independent benchmark must apply calculator rounding.
low_load_factor.filed_tariff_interim_cent_rounding: Not specified in D19. Rounding/tie detail is from official calculator corroboration.
low_load_factor.combined_equality_component_limit: Combined equality need not equalize D19-only variable components; percentage riders may distinguish final bills. Allowing either selector branch at equality is unsafe unless final equivalence is proven; otherwise reject unresolved equality band.

one_time_refund.unknown: Original gives beginning date but no explicit end date or prior-receipt state. Must not repeat automatically.
